result.summary: Found 1 visual defect: restaurant metadata text overlaps in the Popular right now card, making the delivery time unreadable.

issues.description: In the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card, the delivery-time text collides with the following word, rendering as '25-30delivery' with 'min' obscured/overlapping instead of a readable '25-30 min delivery'.
issues.suggestion: Fix the metadata row layout so the time, unit, and 'delivery' label have proper spacing and do not overlap, e.g. '25-30 min · delivery · Ramen'.
